title: Normalize 67 SRD hyphen-space artifacts in generated record strings
description:
Finding source:
- Fable P3 found 67 mid-word hyphen-space artifacts across record strings using /[A-Za-z0-9]+- [a-z]/.
- Examples: "1st- level" in wizard/paladin spellcasting features and candle of invocation, "15- foot cone" in three mephit breath weapons, "20-foot- radius", "two- handed", "self- expression", "10-foot- cube".
- Root cause: line-break dehyphenation inserts a stray space when a compound hyphen falls at a source line break.

Why it matters:
- Visible text quality defect.
- Defeats exact phrase search on gameplay-meaningful compounds.

Acceptance criteria:
- Enumerate all 67 current matches.
- Normalize true extraction artifacts while preserving legitimate source hyphenation.
- Add a regression guard with a small explicit allowlist if needed.
- Confirm no license/provenance/source text is corrupted.
close_reason: Normalized generated SRD hyphen-space artifacts via importer/emitter regeneration; guard added with numeric suspended-range exception.
